newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe Standard Chartered cuts rate to 25.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe Standard Chartered cuts rate to 25.5 pct.

text.p: Standard Chartered Bank of Zimbabwe announced on Tuesday that it had cut to 25.5 percent its minimum lending rate with immediate effect.

"Following the cut in the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe's rediscount rate, Standard Chartered is please to announce a reduction of 3.5 (percentage points) in its minimum lending rate to 25.5 percent with effect from February 11," the bank said in a statement.
It said that deposit rates would also be adjusted.
Last week Zimbabwe's Reserve Bank announced that it had cut its rediscount rate by 3.5 percentage points to 23.5 percent with effect from February 7.
